find:
GRANT SELECT ON updater.plans, updater.plan_approval_outcomes, updater.runs,
  updater.run_events, updater.heartbeat TO control_room_private_web;
replace:
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE ON updater.plans, updater.plan_approval_outcomes, updater.runs,
  updater.run_events, updater.heartbeat TO control_room_private_web;
why: the web login may read the display tables and change nothing: removing the REVOKE is a no-op because the grants were never made, so the mutation grants UPDATE and DELETE outright
